# Case Routing

Support teams route new cases to the right queue.

## Behaviours

### B1 — Route a complete case 🔵 future

A complete case appears in the matching queue.

### B2 — Missing status marker

This malformed heading remains visible as a finding.

### B3 — Keep healthy behaviour after the error 🔵 future

The next canonical behaviour still appears in the estate.

## Rules (Invariants)

- A case belongs to one active queue.
